gloss: to throw out, to give up, to abandon

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {投|な}げ{出|だ}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {投|な}げ{出|だ}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {投|な}げ{出|だ}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to stretch out, to throw out (limbs)
definitions.explanation: To extend one's legs or body casually or carelessly.

definitions.gloss: to give up, to abandon, to quit halfway
definitions.explanation: To abandon a task, responsibility, or commitment before completion.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I sat on the sofa and stretched my legs out.
Sitting with your legs stretched out on the floor is bad manners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す。
⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a habit of giving up when things get difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}さないで⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦やり{遂|と}げよう→やり遂げる：16745_yaritogeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's see it through to the end without quitting halfway.

notes:
CONJUGATION (godan-su):
- Negative: {投|な}げ{出|だ}さない
- Te-form: {投|な}げ{出|だ}して
- Past: {投|な}げ{出|だ}した

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing being thrown out or abandoned.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す: to stretch out one's legs
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す: to abandon one's work
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す: to abandon responsibility
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{投|な}げ{出|だ}す: to quit halfway

USAGE:
Sense 2 carries a negative connotation of irresponsibility. Often used in criticism or self-criticism.
